assertions: artifact garbage collection race: protection is reference-based (active pointer, rollback predecessor, releases referenced by recovery points, recovery points held by non-terminal operations); an expired lease left by a crashed owner does not expose them
bundle retention on the target merges the deployment bundle, lease-protected releases and recovery-point releases into the protected set (deployment.enforceVPSBundleRetentionBestEffort)
limitations: package lane only: the target owner (vrooli cloud-target) is exercised through internal/cloudtarget tests and a stateful fake target in api/vps; QEMU and real-VPS activation subsets are pending EXT-06 (disposable target lane) and EXT-01 (real VPS)

side_by_side is selected only for workloads without persistent data and without pinned manifest ports; the target activator delegates candidate allocation to the lifecycle owner's restart, so a candidate never runs beside the current release yet (recorded limitation)
